segments.name: Commercial Real Estate
segments.description: Sells commercial real estate data, analytics and online marketplaces by subscription.
segments.evidence: Services We operate, develop products, and deliver our services in two reportable segments, Commercial Real Estate and Residential Real Estate.

segments.name: Residential Real Estate

segments.evidence: Residential Real Estate Our residential marketplaces aggregate consumer demand for homes that they can rent or buy and we sell marketing and leads to the agents, owners, landlords, and property management companies that need to reach those consumers with their offerings.
